settings.title: Orders
settings.questions:
How do I track my order?
Can I modify or cancel after it has been placed?
What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answers:
Tracking the status of your order is easy. Once your order has been processed and shipped, you will receive a confirmation email containing a unique tracking number. You can use this tracking number on our website or the carrier's website to monitor the real-time status and location of your package.
Please contact our customer service team immediately if you need to modify or cancel your order. We can only make changes before the order has been shipped. Once shipped, modifications are not possible.
We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay for your convenience.

settings.title: Shipping
settings.questions:
How long does shipping take?
Do you ship internationally?
What are the shipping costs?
settings.answers:
Standard shipping typically takes 5-7 business days within the continental US. Express shipping options are available at checkout for faster delivery (2-3 business days).
Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping times vary by destination, typically 10-20 business days. Customs duties and taxes may apply.
Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your location and order weight. We offer free standard shipping on orders over $75 within the US.

settings.title: Returns
settings.questions:
What is your return policy?
How do I start a return?
When will I receive my refund?
settings.answers:
We offer a 30-day return policy for most items. Products must be unused, in original packaging, and in the same condition you received them. Some items like personalized products or perishables cannot be returned.
To start a return, please contact our customer service team with your order number. We'll provide you with a return shipping label and instructions. You can also initiate a return through your account dashboard.
Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive your returned item. The refund will be issued to your original payment method. Please allow additional time for your bank to process the refund.

settings.title: Warranty
settings.questions:
Do your products come with a warranty?
How do I make a warranty claim?
What does the warranty cover?
settings.answers:
Yes, all our products come with a manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period varies by product, typically ranging from 1 to 3 years. Check your product documentation for specific warranty terms.
To make a warranty claim, please contact our support team with your order number, product details, and description of the issue. We may ask for photos or additional information. Approved claims will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Our warranty covers manufacturing defects and workmanship issues under normal use. It does not cover damage from misuse, accidents, unauthorized repairs, or normal wear and tear. Full warranty terms are included with your product.

settings.title: Wholesale
settings.questions:
Do you offer wholesale pricing?
What are the minimum order requirements?
How do I apply for a wholesale account?
settings.answers:
Yes, we offer wholesale pricing for qualified businesses, retailers, and bulk purchasers. Wholesale discounts range from 20-40% depending on order volume and frequency.
Our minimum wholesale order is typically $500 or 50 units, whichever comes first. Larger orders qualify for better pricing tiers. Contact us for a detailed pricing sheet.
To apply for a wholesale account, please fill out our wholesale application form on the Cooperation page. You'll need to provide your business license, tax ID, and business information. Applications are typically reviewed within 2-3 business days.

settings.title: Gift Cards
settings.questions:
How do gift cards work?
Do gift cards expire?
Can I use multiple gift cards on one order?
settings.answers:
Our digital gift cards are delivered via email and can be redeemed at checkout. Simply enter the gift card code during checkout to apply the balance to your order. Physical gift cards are also available upon request.
No, our gift cards never expire. You can use them whenever you're ready to make a purchase. The full balance remains available until used.
Yes, you can use multiple gift cards on a single order. Simply enter each gift card code at checkout. You can also combine gift cards with other payment methods if the order total exceeds your gift card balance.
